tagline: Curious explainers told over real footage: you flash on screen for half a second, then every sentence gets its own clip, a lime arrow points at the thing, and bold caps captions carry the story.
readiness_note: Best with 12-25 short clips you own per minute of reel; missing clips become built diagrams and scale scenes.

captions: Hook: host flash, then the subject with a measure bracket growing beside a person
Annotation: lime arrow hops to the part being named, keyword chip, credit line top-left
Cliffhanger: the next question with ? marks and the subscribe tap
